{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling errors by coercing to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors (NaN values)
conversion_errors = sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Verify the result by checking the number of completed orders and mean
n_completed = len(completed_orders)

conversion_errors, n_completed, mean_revenue_completed"}
